english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip01: YouTube changes its page structure often. A quick report helps FilterTube update the matching logic before more families are affected.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip02: Copy the profile currently open to your own second device. No protected profile or PIN is required. Switch profiles first if you want to copy a different profile.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip03: Create a protected child/user profile only when you want parent-managed rules, time limits, or viewing access.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip04: Send parent-approved rules, time, and viewing access to an existing protected profile. Use this when both devices are open together.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip05: Best default. Keep both devices open, pair with the code or QR, verify the phrase, then send the update.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip06: Optional advanced path for a trusted home, school, or clinic pickup service. Wi-Fi discovery alone never grants control.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip07: Optional advanced path for a verified device that opens later or is away. The device still validates signed parent updates locally.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip08: Copies a redacted Family Devices map snapshot for a bug report or manual check. It does not include device names, profile IDs, rules, PINs, or update payloads.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip09: Downloads the same redacted Family Devices evidence JSON. Use this when clipboard access is blocked or you want to attach a file to an audit row.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip10: Use live Send Update first. It is the simplest path and does not require a pickup provider.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip11: Advanced delivery is only for verified protected devices that cannot stay open while the parent sends an update.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip12: Configure Internet Pickup for signed updates a verified protected device can collect later. This is not parent authority by itself.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip13: Check whether the configured Internet Pickup provider is reachable.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip14: Configure Home Pickup for a trusted same-network service. The protected device still validates every update.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip15: Check whether the configured Home Pickup service is reachable from this browser.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip16: Protected device check: look for waiting signed parent updates from Internet Pickup or Home Pickup.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip17: Parent device check: see whether a protected device accepted or rejected a saved parent update.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip18: Open this when you are ready to pair a device, type a code, scan a QR, send the reviewed update, or inspect trusted-device details.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip19: Choose what kind of update you want to send: family controls, this profile once, or a full account move.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip20: Choose whether to copy this profile, manage a protected profile, or move a full account.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip21: The wording and controls below follow the update type you select.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip22: The sending device chooses what is offered. Nothing applies before pairing and phrase verification.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip23: Use this for a child, family member, or protected device. It sends parent-approved rules, time limits, and viewing access.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip24: Use this for your own second device. It copies this profile once and does not create parent control.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip25: Use only for reinstall, migration, or full recovery. This sends the wider account backup after verification.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip26: A friendly name shown to the other device during pairing and in trusted-device history.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip27: Choose where this update should land. If left blank, it follows the profile currently open on the other device.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip28: Advanced controls for role, scope, rule source, and merge/replace behavior. Most families can leave this closed.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip29: Open only when you need to repair a link, choose a smaller rule scope, or change merge versus replace behavior.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip30: Relationship decides whether this device sends, receives, or just copies settings once. Family control uses parent-to-protected defaults.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip31: Scope decides what is sent: current profile, Main rules, Kids rules, keywords, channels, time limits, or full backup.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip32: For keyword, channel, and video rule sends, choose whether the local Main YouTube or YouTube Kids rules are used.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip33: Saved protected profiles from the connected device appear here when they can be targeted directly.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip34: Merge adds the selected rules. Replace overwrites only the selected scope for managed protected devices.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip35: Create a pairing code or QR on this device. The other device must join and show the same safety phrase.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip36: Send the selected update after both devices connect and the safety phrase is confirmed.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip37: Save parent trust only for devices that should keep receiving approved updates for a protected profile.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip38: Close this pairing session. It does not remove existing rules or saved trusted-device links.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip39: Shows whether this device is idle, hosting, joining, connected, verified, or ready to send.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip40: Both devices must show the same safety phrase before anything is trusted.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip41: Click only if both devices display the same safety phrase. This prevents sending to the wrong device.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip42: Use this side when another device already created a pairing code or QR.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip43: Join the code from the other device. Rules do not apply until the safety phrase is confirmed.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip44: The code only connects devices. It does not give permission to change rules until both sides verify the same phrase.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip45: This device is joining a session started somewhere else.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip46: The meeting service helps devices find each other. After the handshake, signed settings move between devices and still need local validation.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip47: Advanced link for the public meeting service. It helps with pairing, but it should not read your private settings payload.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip48: Type the short code shown on the other device, then verify the same safety phrase on both screens.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip49: Join the live pairing session from the other device. Nothing applies until the phrase is confirmed.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip50: This link contains pairing information only. The other device still has to verify the same safety phrase.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip51: Copy the pairing link for another device. The receiving device still has to verify the same safety phrase.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip52: Start pairing first, then this area shows a QR or status message for the other device.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip53: Trusted devices remember a verified relationship so future sends are easier.
english.dashboard.helpBubble.tip54: Saved trust is not a live connection and never skips local validation.
